_comment: Template for the browser-observable half of the PRD §18 checklist. Copy to evidence.json, fill in what you actually saw, then run: node src/cli.js --url <url> --evidence evidence.json --out ../docs/launch-verification-RFC-1.md
checker: name of the person who ran the checks
_note_comment: Optional free text carried verbatim into the record under "Checker's note" — browser and version, network used, anything a reader needs to judge the run.

browser._comment: One entry per viewport. PRD §18 requires 375 px and at least 1280 px.
browser._requests_comment: Every entry from the devtools network panel. A same-origin /favicon.ico 404 is exempt (PRD Q3); anything else beyond the document fails CHK-6.

secondCheck._comment: The GA gate: repeat from another device or network.
secondCheck.network: e.g. mobile tethering on a different phone
